mapper.select: SELECT session_id AS sessionId, member_id AS memberId, goods_id AS goodsId, sales_id AS salesId, status, expire_at AS expireAt FROM tb_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at > NOW()

SELECT seat_id AS seatId, seatassign_id AS seatassignId, sales_id AS salesId, seat_grade AS seatGrade, floor AS floor, row_no AS rowNo, seat_no AS seatNo, seat_status AS seatStatus, version AS version FROM tb_goods_seatassign_details WHERE seat_id = #{seatId} AND sales_id = #{salesId}
FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_goods_seatassign SET remain_cnt = remain_cnt - 1, hold_cnt = hold_cnt + 1 WHERE seatassign_id = #{seatassignId} AND remain_cnt > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_seat_hold ( session_id, member_id, sales_id, seat_id, status, hold_expire_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{memberId}, #{salesId}, #{seatId}, #{status}, #{holdExpireAt} )
